edition_intro: You don't wait for opportunity — you position yourself for it. This edition surfaces 14 of the most consequential open opportunities for ambitious young Nigerians right now: fully funded scholarships to the world's top institutions, grants for founders ready to scale, free conferences on your doorstep, high-stakes competitions with real prize money, and certifications that signal your skills to global employers. Everything here has a verified deadline and a direct application link. Pick your shots, then go take them.

posts.title: Chevening Scholarship 2027 — Fully Funded UK Master's Degree
posts.summary: The UK government's flagship global scholarship funds a one-year master's at any UK university, making it one of the most prestigious and career-transforming awards a young Nigerian professional can win.
posts.eligibility: Nigerian citizens with a bachelor's degree, at least 2,800 hours (approx. 2 years) of post-undergraduate work experience, and a commitment to return to Nigeria for at least two years after the award.

posts.title: Schwarzman Scholars 2027–2028 — Fully Funded Master's at Tsinghua University, China
posts.summary: A fully funded one-year Master's in Global Affairs at Beijing's Tsinghua University, designed to build the next generation of global leaders who can navigate an increasingly China-shaped world.
posts.eligibility: Open globally (including all Nigerians) aged 18–28 as of 1 August 2027, holding a bachelor's degree; must demonstrate extraordinary leadership, academic excellence, and entrepreneurial spirit.

posts.title: UK GREAT Scholarship 2026–27 — £10,000 Towards a UK Postgraduate Degree
posts.summary: A British Council and UK government-backed scholarship offering Nigerian students £10,000 toward postgraduate tuition fees at leading UK universities for the 2026–27 academic year.
posts.deadline: Rolling — varies by institution (check individual university pages)
posts.eligibility: Nigerian nationals applying for a one-year taught postgraduate course at participating UK universities for the 2026–27 intake; self-funded applicants only.

posts.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Pan-Atlantic University — Full Scholarship
posts.summary: A full scholarship for exceptional young Africans facing financial or socio-economic barriers to study at Pan-Atlantic University (home of Lagos Business School) in Nigeria, with priority for women, refugees, and persons with disabilities.
posts.eligibility: Young Africans with demonstrated academic excellence, financial need, and leadership potential; priority given to young women, refugees and displaced youths, and young persons with disabilities.

posts.title: IFC SME Growth Accelerator 2026 — Up to $1.5 Million for High-Potential SMEs
posts.summary: The International Finance Corporation is offering grant funding of $50,000–$1.5 million to high-potential SMEs in Africa, paired with technical assistance, mentorship, and access to IFC's global investment networks.
posts.eligibility: For-profit SMEs with 10–250 employees and verified annual revenue between $250,000–$10 million, operating in Africa, Asia, or Latin America with a scalable, growth-ready business model.

posts.title: All On Off-Grid Energy Challenge 2026 — $200,000–$1 Million for Nigerian Clean Energy Innovators
posts.summary: All On, an off-grid energy access investor backed by Shell, is offering $200,000–$1 million in blended funding (grants + commercial financing) to innovative Nigerian companies solving electricity access challenges.
posts.eligibility: Majority Nigerian-owned and managed, legally registered and operating for-profit companies in Nigeria with an innovative, commercially viable off-grid or clean energy solution targeting underserved communities.

posts.title: Tony Elumelu Foundation (TEF) Entrepreneurship Programme 2027 — $5,000 Seed Capital + Training
posts.summary: Africa's most celebrated entrepreneurship programme gives young African founders $5,000 in non-refundable seed capital, world-class business training, mentorship, and access to the continent's largest entrepreneurship network — and it returns in January 2027.
posts.eligibility: African entrepreneurs from all 54 African countries with a business idea or early-stage business; open to all sectors; no age cap, but prioritises young founders.

posts.title: Nigeria Innovation Summit (NIS) 11.0 — Free, Lagos
posts.summary: West Africa's biggest innovation gathering — entirely free to attend — brings together AI thinkers, startup founders, investors, and policymakers in Lagos on October 6, 2026 under the theme 'Innovating in the Age of AI.'
posts.eligibility: Open to all — startup founders, students, tech professionals, policymakers, researchers, and anyone interested in innovation and technology in Nigeria and Africa.

posts.title: GITEX Nigeria 2026 — West Africa's Largest Tech & Startup Show (Free Startup Festival Access)
posts.summary: The global GITEX brand lands in Nigeria for its 2026 edition, spanning Abuja (August 31) and Lagos (September 2–3), with a free Startup Festival that connects 1,000+ startups with 300+ investors.
posts.eligibility: Open to all tech professionals, startup founders, entrepreneurs, investors, government representatives, and innovators; free Startup Festival passes available through official registration portal.

posts.title: Wema Bank Hackaholics 7.0 — ₦200 Million Prize Pool
posts.summary: Wema Bank's flagship open innovation hackathon is back with a massive ₦200 million cumulative prize pool, targeting Nigerian developers, designers, and tech innovators building solutions in financial inclusion, healthcare, and digital transformation.
posts.deadline: Rolling — applications open, check official portal for cohort dates
posts.eligibility: Teams of up to 3 members; Nigerian developers, UI/UX designers, and tech innovators; at least one team member must have a technical background; at least one founder or decision-maker must actively lead pitches.

posts.title: Hack-Nation 5th Global AI Hackathon 2026 — $30,000+ in Prizes
posts.summary: Rooted in the MIT ecosystem, this global 24-hour AI hackathon invites developers, innovators, and entrepreneurs worldwide — including Nigerians — to build real AI-powered solutions and compete for over $30,000 in prizes.
posts.deadline: Rolling — check official Hack-Nation portal for cohort deadline
posts.eligibility: Open globally to developers, innovators, AI enthusiasts, students, and entrepreneurs; individuals or teams; no specific residency requirement.

posts.title: Oxford Saïd Global Climate Tech Challenge 2026 — Prestigious Innovation Competition
posts.summary: Oxford Saïd Business School's Global Climate Tech Challenge invites innovators and entrepreneurs worldwide to pitch climate technology solutions, offering global visibility and strategic support to finalists.
posts.eligibility: Open to entrepreneurs, innovators, students, and organisations globally working on scalable climate technology solutions; teams or individuals welcome.

posts.title: Google Cloud Skills Boost — Free AI & Cloud Skill Badges (Rolling, Always Open)
posts.summary: Google's official learning platform offers 300+ free courses, real hands-on cloud labs, and shareable skill badges in AI, machine learning, data engineering, and cloud architecture — no credit card required for the free tier.
posts.eligibility: Open globally to anyone; no prerequisites for beginner-level courses; university students can request 200 free learning credits; the GEAR programme offers 35 monthly free credits to all registered users.

posts.title: ALX Africa Tech Programmes — Subsidised Career Certifications in Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Cloud Computing & More
posts.summary: ALX Africa, in partnership with the Mastercard Foundation, offers young Nigerians access to its full portfolio of tech career programmes — software engineering, data analytics, cloud computing, AI career essentials, and more — for as little as $5/month.
posts.eligibility: Young Africans, primarily aged 18–35, residing in Nigeria; eligible learners can access sponsored placement (significantly reduced cost) through the Mastercard Foundation partnership; small admin fee applies.
